reason: The plugin primarily monitors and displays model-provider balances, usage, and quota windows in DSH through a live sidebar panel and settings section, using host-side provider API queries.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中集中查看已配置模型供应商的余额、用量和额度窗口，并通过侧边栏面板与设置页进行刷新。
summaries.en: View balances, usage, and quota windows for configured model providers in DSH through a live sidebar panel and settings page.

capabilities: Reads configured model-provider credentials on the host
Displays normalized quota and usage data in the DSH web GUI
Automatically polls configured providers every 60 seconds
Adds sidebar and settings-page interface components through a bundle patch
